import pandas as pd

# Load downtime data
dt = pd.read_excel('data/downtime.xlsx', sheet_name='정지이력')
# Calculate week number based on start date 2026-03-02
start_date = pd.Timestamp('2026-03-02')
dt['주차'] = ((dt['일자'] - start_date).dt.days // 7) + 1
# Aggregate total downtime hours per week
dt_weekly = dt.groupby('주차')['정지시간(분)'].sum().reset_index()
dt_weekly['총정지시간(h)'] = dt_weekly['정지시간(분)'] / 60.0

# Load run log weekly summary
rl = pd.read_excel('data/run_log.xlsx', sheet_name='주간요약')

# Merge the two datasets on '주차'
merged = pd.merge(rl, dt_weekly[['주차', '총정지시간(h)']], on='주차', how='left')
merged['총정지시간(h)'] = merged['총정지시간(h)'].fillna(0)

# Update df to be used by the chart
df = merged.copy()
